This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩玩儿：玩儿，The reduplicated verb suggests a brief or casual action, which conflicts with an activity lasting from morning to night. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了：有一个小男孩叫孟子；他小的时候，爸爸很早就去世了，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with both a description and his name before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的家：孟子的家，After the father was mentioned, this pronoun could refer to either Mengzi or his father; repeat Mengzi’s name to make the possessor clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 从早到晚的持续活动不适合用动词重叠“玩玩儿”，改为“玩儿”正确。
孟子首次出现时需要先介绍人物，再使用“他”。
前句刚提到父亲，“他的家”可能指孟子或父亲，重复“孟子”能消除指代歧义。
